core_values.name: SZV Value: I Lead The Way
core_values.behaviors: Leads by example, coaches others, shares knowledge, demonstrates accountability, and drives innovation and improvement.

core_values.name: SZV Value: I Love To Serve
core_values.behaviors: Delivers excellent customer service, takes ownership of requests, represents SZV positively, and demonstrates service excellence.

core_values.name: SZV Value: I Collaborate and Work Well With Others
core_values.behaviors: Encourages teamwork, communicates respectfully, provides constructive feedback, and supports psychological safety.

core_values.name: SZV Value: I Show Respect
core_values.behaviors: Behaves professionally, considers other opinions, and follows up on commitments.

core_values.name: SZV Value: I Am Dependable
core_values.behaviors: Takes ownership, delivers accurate information, and meets commitments and timelines.

onboarding.note: Simulated onboarding via Tasks API (Factorial has no public onboarding-process endpoint).

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Offer accepted & start date confirmed
tasks.content: Confirm offer acceptance and start date for Keisha Peterson (Customer Care). Owners: People & Culture.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Collect employment documents
tasks.content: Collect ID/passport, bank details, emergency contact, and signed contract pack for the new hire.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Policy acknowledgements
tasks.content: Obtain acknowledgements for SZV code of conduct, confidentiality, and core values policies.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: First-day agenda & orientation sessions
tasks.content: Schedule first-day agenda: office tour, team intro, Customer Care systems overview, MySZV overview.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: ICT — email, accounts & system access
tasks.content: Create user/email accounts and grant access to Customer Care tools, intranet, and required apps.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Facilities — badge, workspace & equipment
tasks.content: Prepare badge, desk/workspace at Harbour View Building, and allocate laptop/headset.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Benefits enrollment (ZV / pension)
tasks.content: Complete benefits enrollment guidance: medical insurance status, pension registration, and dependent info if applicable.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Payroll & HRIS registration
tasks.content: Activate payroll profile, bank account, and organization chart placement for the new hire.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: Assign mandatory trainings
tasks.content: Assign SZV Core Values in Daily Work and role orientation learning. Track completion evidence.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: 1-week check-in
tasks.content: Confirm access, equipment, orientation completion, and immediate support needs.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: 30-day check-in
tasks.content: Review integration, role clarity, and early training needs. Capture actions.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: 60-day check-in
tasks.content: Review progress, capability development, and support gaps. Escalate if needed.

tasks.name: SZV Onboarding: 90-day / probation evaluation
tasks.content: Complete probation evaluation with manager and People & Culture. Document decision and development plan.
